summary: Find a complete cyan separator row or column and transpose when it is horizontal so the separator is vertical. Count yellow cells on each side globally; choose the left side only when its count is strictly greater, otherwise choose the right side. For each normalized row containing yellow on the selected side: recolor every original yellow cell in that row green; extend yellow from the selected marker nearest the separator up to the separator; count red cells on the opposite side; fill cyan from the separator across that side; and rebuild exactly that many red cells flush with the far edge. Leave rows without selected-side yellow unchanged, then transpose back when needed.
